digest: Coverage centred on world champion Kimi Antonelli leading a Mercedes one-two ahead of George Russell to sweep Friday running, in a session disrupted by two red flags (Autosport, Motorsport.com, BBC Sport). Motorsport.com's analysis had Antonelli nearly a second clear of Verstappen on long runs, with Lando Norris saying Mercedes were "at a different level". Charles Leclerc described a "very, very difficult" day after an early spin linked to a lack of grip at Ferrari, while Verstappen reported a "disconnect" as Red Bull sought to solve a "massive limitation" (Motorsport.com).
